_comment: Loads into shopify_returns. One completed historical return, so the customer arrives with real return history and long-term memory has something to recall.

returns.customer_note: Well built case but the mid tower is too tight for a 332mm card with the front fans in. Would try the full tower.
returns.resolution_note: Refunded in full. Customer advised the Full Tower clears 400mm cards and subsequently reordered it (ORD-1001).
